sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profiles" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "level" TEXT NOT NULL, "goal" TEXT NOT NULL, "daily_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "show_pinyin" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("show_pinyin" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, CHECK (length(trim(name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 160), CHECK (level IN ('beginner', 'basics', 'experienced')), CHECK (goal IN ('everyday', 'travel', 'reading')), CHECK (daily_minutes IN (5, 10, 15, 20)));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_preferences" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "selected_profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (id = 1));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "foundation_progress" ("profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles (id), "step" INTEGER NOT NULL, "completed" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("completed" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("profile_id"), CHECK (step BETWEEN 0 AND 8));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vocabulary_progress" ("profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles (id), "word_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "stage" TEXT NOT NULL, "due_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "successful_reviews" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("profile_id", "word_id"), CHECK (length(word_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 100), CHECK (stage IN ('learning', 'review', 'relearning')), CHECK (due_at_ms >= 0), CHECK (version > 0), CHECK (successful_reviews >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vocabulary_attempts" ("event_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles (id), "word_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "version_before" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_review" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_review" IN (0, 1)), "answers_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "questions_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "passed" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("passed" IN (0, 1)), "answered_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "next_due_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "next_stage" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("event_id"), CHECK (length(event_id) = 32), CHECK (content_revision > 0), CHECK (version_before >= 0), CHECK (answered_at_ms >= 0), CHECK (next_due_at_ms >= answered_at_ms), CHECK (next_stage IN ('learning', 'review', 'relearning')), UNIQUE (profile_id, word_id, version_before));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "practice_responses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles (id), "word_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "question_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "correct" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("correct" IN (0, 1)), "answered_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "content_packs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "content_schema" INTEGER NOT NULL, "canonical_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (revision > 0), CHECK (content_schema BETWEEN 1 AND 3));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "content_words" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_packs (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "hanzi" TEXT NOT NULL, "pinyin" TEXT NOT NULL, "metadata_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (position >= 0), UNIQUE (pack_id, position));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "content_examples" ("word_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_words (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("word_id", "position"), CHECK (position BETWEEN 0 AND 4));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "content_exercises" ("word_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_words (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "question_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("word_id", "question_id"), CHECK (position BETWEEN 0 AND 23), UNIQUE (word_id, position));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "curriculum_words" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "content_schema" INTEGER NOT NULL, "hanzi" TEXT NOT NULL, "pinyin" TEXT NOT NULL, "meaning" TEXT NOT NULL, "search_text" TEXT NOT NULL, "default_position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "metadata_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "curriculum_sentences" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "curriculum_examples" ("word_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES curriculum_words (id), "sentence_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES curriculum_sentences (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("word_id", "position"), UNIQUE(word_id, sentence_id), CHECK(position BETWEEN 0 AND 4));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "curriculum_audio" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sentence_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES curriculum_sentences (id), "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_available" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("local_available" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "curriculum_questions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "word_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES curriculum_words (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE(word_id, position), CHECK(position BETWEEN 0 AND 23));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "curriculum_installs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "digest" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "learning_queue" ("profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles (id), "word_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES curriculum_words (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("profile_id", "word_id"), CHECK(position >= 0));
CREATE INDEX curriculum_audio_sentence ON curriculum_audio (sentence_id)
CREATE INDEX curriculum_question_word ON curriculum_questions (word_id, position)
CREATE INDEX queue_profile_position ON learning_queue (profile_id, position, word_id)
